## Ridge trace plot
We visualize how regression coefficients change with different penalty parameter $\lambda$ in ridge regression:
$\hat{\beta}^{ridge} = (X^\top X + \lambda I)^{-1}X^\top y$


```{r ridge-plot}
lambda_seq <- exp(seq(log(0.1), log(500), length.out = 25))
coef_mat <- matrix(nrow = length(lambda_seq), ncol = 13)

form <- medv ~ crim + zn + indus + chas + nox + rm + age + dis + rad + tax + ptratio + b + lstat

for(i in seq_along(lambda_seq)){
  fit <- ridgereg(form, data = BostonHousing, lambda = lambda_seq[i])
  coef_mat[i,] <- coef(fit)[-1]
}

matplot(lambda_seq, coef_mat, type = "l", lty =1, log="x",
        xlab = "Lambda", ylab = "Coefficients",
        main = "Ridge trace plot, custom ridgereg function")
legend("topright", colnames(BostonHousing)[1:13], lty=1, col=1:13, cex=0.45)
```
